answer: Picture a wharf where each docking agent must clear a per-epoch honeypot: the seed plants a decoy challenge onto thin grading panels. A genuinely independent agent scores it by its own reasoning, but one shared inference pipeline wearing many masks returns the identical cipher-signed verdict across every identity it controls. We correlate those collisions and freeze the whole cluster. To fake independence the attacker must run a separate model per mask, so the real cost is distinct compute for every sybil rather than one ivory brain doing the thinking for all of them.
